description: Defines the PdfStructureElement class representing a structure tree root in a PDF, including methods for managing structure hierarchy, attributes, and related keys.

classes.name: PdfStructureElement
classes.description: Represents a structure element in a PDF's structure hierarchy, with methods for managing its children, attributes, and keys.

methods.name: PdfStructureElement
methods.description: Constructors for initializing a structure element, optionally with a document context.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares the structure element and its children for saving by simplifying arrays and attributes.

methods.name: GetKids
methods.description: Retrieves all child dictionaries stored under the '/K' key, handling arrays and references.

methods.name: GetPdfDictionary
methods.description: Returns the PdfDictionary from a PdfItem, resolving references if necessary.

methods.name: SimplifyKidsArray
methods.description: Simplifies the '/K' array if it contains only one item.

methods.name: SimplifyAttributes
methods.description: Removes empty or unnecessary attribute dictionaries or arrays from the element.

methods.name: AttributeDictionaryIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a given attribute dictionary is empty or only contains the '/O' key.

methods.name: LayoutAttributes
methods.description: Gets or creates the PdfLayoutAttributes instance in '/A'.

methods.name: TableAttributes
methods.description: Gets or creates the PdfTableAttributes instance in '/A'.

methods.name: GetAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an attribute object of type T within the '/A' array.
